text:
- Total revenue in TW was £208.7k, down 27.7% WoW from £288.8k in LW and down 9.9% YoY against £231.8k in LY.
- Total units in TW reached 106,817, down 6.6% WoW, while total orders came in at 440, down 14.6% WoW.
- United Kingdom ranked 1 in TW with £193.4k, holding a 92.6% share of total revenue.
- Germany ranked 2 in TW with £4.5k and a 2.2% share, ahead of Sweden at rank 3 with £3.8k and a 1.8% share.
- The top three countries combined accounted for 96.6% of total TW revenue.
- United Kingdom posted the largest absolute decline in TW, down £83.9k WoW, a drop of 30.3% WoW.
- Sweden recorded the largest absolute gain in TW at £3.8k WoW.
- Spain rose 420.3% WoW and Australia rose 60.6% WoW, while France fell 87.3% WoW.
